notes.title: Hi everyone!
notes.content:
So, I'm glad that my game is now available on steam. At the moment, it is in active development. Beta testing is planned for September and after its completion, there will be a release in the same month.

If you have any questions or suggestions about Drinks Company Tycoon, it's time to share it here.

And if you are interested in the game, please don't forget to add it to the wishlist and tell other people about the project, of course, who may be interested in it. This is very important for me as an indie developer. That's all for now, thanks for your attention.
